source: Route geometry adapted from newzealandpaul/Shipping-Lanes (CC-BY 4.0), itself georeferenced from the CIA "Map of the World's Oceans" (Oct 2012). https://github.com/newzealandpaul/Shipping-Lanes
note: Real digitized shipping-lane geometry, not live AIS tracking -- these are the CIA-classified 'Major' global trade routes (plus the Bosphorus, classified 'Middle') as of the source map, which is why routes may not perfectly reflect present-day traffic shifts.
